reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data and pre-existing/independent IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor; Section 14.2 vests Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment plus personnel assignments and further assurances.

Section 14.3 leaves only Vendor Technology with Vendor and pulls in the Section 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence (including modify and create derivative works) for embedded Vendor Technology — matching the preferred licence-back position.
Section 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument identifying exploitation rights, and feedback is voluntary with Customer's own use rights preserved; no walk-away trigger appears.

Definitions reinforce compliance: 'Customer Data' captures derived output and excludes only non-linkable telemetry, and 'Vendor Technology' expressly excludes Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed (redline is identical to the original) and the deterministic check confirms no assignment of Customer IP/data to Vendor.
